title: 第17章 开眼术升级突破后天境界第18章 新道术有手就会直接拉满
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
任府。
师徒一行人回到大堂之内。
噗通！
未等九叔发声，秋生直直跪下，双手捏着耳根。
已经做好被罚的准备。
“你还知道自己错了！”
九叔脸色一沉严肃说道。
文才见状，连忙求情道：“师父，你看秋生都知道错了，要不……”
“要不什么？”
九叔眼神一冷，直勾勾盯着文才。
“没没没，我什么都没说，我先去休息了。”
文才见状，连忙脚底抹油开溜！
“别跪了，起来，丢人现眼。”
九叔催促一声，没好气道。
这在任府大堂，跪着像什么话！
“师父，我就知道你对我好！”
秋生闻言眼睛一亮，连忙翻起身来！
九叔面色不改，淡淡道：“练一夜的功，明日布置任府的事，交给你！”
“师父，你……”
秋生也没想到，这一回师父真这么生气。

原本还想着先表态度，让师父消气呢！
搞半天，是换个惩罚方式啊？
“时间不早了，去休息吧。”
九叔压根没再搭理秋生，冲林凡说了一声。
转身往房内走去，无奈的摇了摇头。
“好好练。”
林凡冲秋生笑笑，转身往房间走去。
哪里有空废话，功德攒够了！
技能点也不少！
“大师兄……”
秋生还想说什么，林凡早已没了踪影。
只好乖乖扎着马步，满脸苦涩，在任家大院中练功。
……
房内。
林凡关上大门，立刻盘腿坐下，心里喊道：“系统，升级锁魂驱邪符。”
【叮！宿主消耗技能点，锁魂驱邪符从入门提升至小成！】
【叮！宿主消耗技能点，锁魂驱邪符从小成提升至大成！】
content_en:
Renfu.
The master and apprentice returned to the lobby.
Plop!
Before Uncle Jiu could speak, Qiu Sheng knelt down and pinched the base of his ears with both hands.
Be prepared to be punished.
"You still know you are wrong!"
Uncle Jiu said with a serious look on his face.
Seeing this, Wen Cai quickly begged for mercy: "Master, you know Qiu Sheng is wrong, otherwise..."
"What else?"
Uncle Jiu's eyes turned cold and he stared straight at Wen Cai.
"No, no, no, I didn't say anything. I'm going to rest first."
When Wencai saw this, he quickly rubbed oil on his feet and ran away!
"Stop kneeling, get up, it's embarrassing."
Uncle Jiu urged him and said angrily.
What does it sound like to kneel down in the lobby of Ren Mansion?
"Master, I knew you were good to me!"
Qiu Sheng's eyes lit up when he heard this and he quickly stood up!
Uncle Jiu's expression did not change, and he said calmly: "Practice all night, I will leave it to you to arrange the affairs of the Ren Mansion tomorrow!"
"Master, you..."
Qiu Sheng also didn't expect that the master would be so angry this time.
I originally wanted to show my attitude first and let Master calm down!
Doing it for a long time is a different way of punishment?
"It's getting late, let's go and rest."
Uncle Jiu ignored Qiu Sheng and spoke to Lin Fan.
He turned around and walked into the room, shaking his head helplessly.
"Practice hard."
Lin Fan smiled at Qiu Sheng, turned around and walked towards the room.
There is no time to talk nonsense, I have accumulated enough merits!
There are also a lot of skill points!
"Elder brother..."
What else Qiu Sheng wanted to say, but Lin Fan had already disappeared.
He had no choice but to sit on his horse and practice kung fu in the courtyard of the Ren family with a bitter look on his face.
…
inside the room.
Lin Fan closed the door and immediately sat down cross-legged, shouting in his heart: "System, upgrade the Soul Locking and Evil Expelling Talisman."
[Ding! The host consumes skill points, and the Soul Locking Exorcist Talisman is upgraded from entry level to accomplished! 】
[Ding! The host consumes skill points, and the Soul Locking Exorcist Talisman is upgraded from a minor achievement to a Dacheng achievement! 】
